logic16_candidate.origin: new local pure-PyTorch experimental implementation of 16 two-input truth table mixtures; no archive runtime imports, no CUDA extension or external model weights

read_only_reference.access: read-only source retrieval; no package installation, CUDA code import or wholesale code copy

changes_and_limits: Local truth table convention places corner00 in least significant mask bit (A=12); official reference places corner00 in most significant bit (A=3)
Independent Bernoulli multilinear relaxation, no interpretation as correlated hidden-wire joint probability
Three soft-gate layers and a real linear head; train and eval remain soft, no discrete argmax inference
Fixed persistent topology buffers and pass-A biased initialization; not the original architecture/protocol reproduction
No cipher keys, target labels or true cipher intermediate states are model inputs
No scientific fitting or new GPU experiment in this implementation stage; synthetic controls only
No claim of novelty, SIMON representability, optimization guarantee or performance improvement
